goal: PRISM-Q3 pure-Quest continuous probabilistic surface reconstruction

nodes.title: Preserve the fork/build baseline and activate the canonical PRISM branch
acceptance: Original QuestRoomScan-derived Android/Vulkan app builds, deploys, and scans on Quest 3/3S
All pre-PRISM implementation work and its old DAG are preserved on a separate pushed archive branch
PRISM development has its own pushed branch and one canonical reconstruction specification
No captures, generated builds, addresses, credentials, or device identifiers enter git
evidence: Hybrid checkpoint e9f37c1 and original DAG are pushed at origin/archive/hybrid-diffsoup-checkpoint-20260820
Active pushed branch feat/quest-radiance-meshlets contains control checkpoint 9fee431
specka.md defines the single canonical PRISM-Q3 product, mathematics, GPU passes, persistence, export, and acceptance corpus

nodes.title: Implement coherent 2x RGB + 2x depth + exact pose/calibration GPU capture
acceptance: Immutable StereoRigFrame exposes RGB-L/R, depth-L/R, independent timestamps, per-camera poses, intrinsics, extrinsics, formats, dimensions, calibration epoch, and GPU ownership leases
Both Meta passthrough cameras and stereo environment-depth views are acquired without CPU color/depth copies in the mapper path
Pairing rejects stale, out-of-order, missing-eye, pose-invalid, or calibration-mismatched data instead of silently fusing it
Diagnostics/capture dump proves correct eye ordering, timestamp deltas, poses, calibration, and direct GPU handles on Quest 3/3S
Unit tests cover contracts/lifetimes and a physical Quest test captures a valid coherent frame sequence

nodes.title: Implement immutable rig calibration, ray LUTs, and depth normalization
acceptance: Calibration epochs fail closed and precompute normalized RGB/depth rays plus rigid inter-sensor transforms
Depth normalization preserves independent eyes and one metric convention with validity/range metadata
Per-pixel passes do not recompute inverse intrinsics and cross-sensor projection remains candidate-depth dependent
CPU reference and real-GPU fixtures agree within declared precision
Physical projection of calibrated rays aligns with measured Quest views

nodes.title: Implement L/R depth consensus, learned sigma, robust normals, and boundary confidence
acceptance: Depth eyes are geometrically cross-checked and disagreement is classified, never blindly averaged
Range-binned robust MAD/EMA learns sensor residual sigma from stable surfaces and propagates per-pixel uncertainty factors
Discontinuity-aware plane fitting emits position, oriented normal, and normal confidence
Depth/normal/RGB evidence emits a non-destructive boundary-confidence field
GPU tests and Quest fixtures cover planes, oblique surfaces, silhouettes, mixed pixels, missing depth, thin objects, and motion

nodes.title: Implement dual-eye prediction raster of current chart meshlets
acceptance: Published meshlets rasterize PredDepth, PredNormal, PredChartID, PredUV, PredSigma, generation, sidedness, and confidence from exact depth-eye poses
Hardware depth testing produces the front-most visible compatible surface with no CPU geometry traversal
Targets are generation-safe and double-buffered so classification never consumes incomplete output
Synthetic occlusion/layer fixtures and physical overlay validate projection and visibility in both eyes

nodes.title: Implement exhaustive first-hit ray classification
acceptance: Every valid ray is classified exactly once as MATCH, NEW_FRONT, BEHIND, NEW_LAYER, UNSEEN, BOUNDARY, or INVALID
Gates use measured/predicted posterior sigma, normal, sidedness, visibility ordering, boundary support, and generation validity
BEHIND only accumulates supported front-space contradiction and nothing behind a first hit is carved
Residual bimodality can select a new hypothesis/split even for similar normals
CPU contract and real-GPU parity cover all classes, occlusions, stale generations, and adversarial edge cases

nodes.title: Implement robust GPU SurfaceChart spawn
acceptance: UNSEEN/NEW_FRONT samples are tile-component clustered by depth/normal continuity entirely on GPU
Local PCA establishes a stable one-sided tangent frame and bounded two-pass IRLS/Huber fits the quadratic base
Actual support determines extent and allocates stable ID/generation without a global primitive size
Bounded allocator handles overflow without corrupting published charts
Quest test spawns stable charts on planar, curved, small-object, and partial-view geometry

nodes.title: Implement 6x6 information-filter chart refinement and posterior uncertainty
acceptance: MATCH observations robustly accumulate quadratic-basis H/g sufficient statistics on GPU
Deterministic regularized 6x6 Cholesky solve updates chart parameters and covariance/sigma without simple averaging
Information rises and uncertainty shrinks for consistent revisits
A lower-information distant, grazing, noisy, or blurred measurement cannot move stable close geometry beyond its tighter posterior bound
Synthetic ordering tests and physical repeat passes demonstrate monotonic or unchanged error

nodes.title: Implement multihypothesis one-sided and bimodal surface geometry
acceptance: Orientation-, sidedness-, visibility-, or residual-mode-incompatible evidence creates an independent chart hypothesis
Nearby parallel/opposing surfaces never proximity-merge and contradictory evidence is not averaged
Layer association remains stable when revisiting either side and under partial occlusion
Physical front/back scans retain independent 5/10/20/50 mm plates whenever sensor evidence resolves them
First-side geometry survives all second-side and return passes

nodes.title: Implement persistent multi-view 3D BoundaryCurves
acceptance: Depth/normal/RGB/visibility/coverage evidence accumulates into stable uncertainty-bearing spline controls with chart-side relations
Promotion/retirement requires consistent multi-view evidence and one noisy edge is non-destructive
Projected curves search a narrow image-normal band and triangulate sub-depth-pixel 3D updates from calibrated views
Boundaries constrain association, UV domains, topology, and tessellation
Physical frames, corners, plate edges, pipes, rails, and recesses show lower edge error than raw depth alone

nodes.title: Implement chart split/merge and hierarchical displacement microtiles
acceptance: Quadratic residual updates logical Grid16 displacement with information/sigma/support/coverage and monotonic quality
Measured footprint can allocate recursive sparse microtiles so Grid16 is not a detail ceiling
Bimodality, boundaries, curvature, non-single-valued support, or incompatible normals split into 2-4 children with statistics preserved
Merge requires compatible sidedness/continuation/normal/appearance and no persistent boundary
Planes simplify while pipes, frames, folds, gaps, relief, and thin detail remain geometrically faithful

nodes.title: Implement adaptive GPU meshlets, culling, dynamic LOD, and indirect rendering
acceptance: Charts and boundaries materialize entirely on GPU into inactive generation-safe meshlet buffers
Adaptive tessellation follows analytic error, microtile detail, confidence, and exact BoundaryCurves without silhouette bridges
GPU frustum/Hi-Z culling and screen-space error generate indirect draw lists with independent geometry/appearance LOD
No synchronous readback, CPU count, CPU mesh, or per-frame geometry traversal exists in the production path
Published geometry remains stable during rebuild and close viewing reveals maximum measured detail

nodes.title: Implement infinite chunk paging, native PRISM persistence, restart, and revisit
acceptance: Chunks store local charts, posterior statistics, sigma, boundaries, displacement/microtiles, appearance pages, meshlet cache, transforms, and keyframe references under a versioned PRISM schema
Current/overlap/visible/dirty chunks are GPU-resident while durable distant pages evict and rehydrate on demand
Fenced async immutable dirty-page staging never blocks capture/render and previous complete revision survives interruption
Revisit resumes the same posterior and publishes a monotonic revision
At least 20 transitions and returns reproduce none of the archived Finalizing/disappearance failure

nodes.title: Implement surface-conditioned L/R narrow stereo focusing
acceptance: Only unresolved/information-positive chart regions evaluate a posterior-centered normal interval
Adaptive coarse/fine candidates use calibrated L/R Census plus gradient cost and parabolic sub-step fit
Best-versus-second-best, texture, occlusion, calibration, pose, and L/R checks reject ambiguity
Accepted updates enter chart information/displacement state rather than a detached depth map
Physical textured targets demonstrate lower surface error than native depth without degrading weak-texture regions

nodes.title: Implement temporal ray-bundle focusing and information-gain keyframes
acceptance: Per-chart active views maximize sharpness, footprint, angular/baseline diversity, frontality, visibility, and unresolved information
Known chart/poses reproject normal-offset candidates into current stereo plus 4-8 best temporal views without feature matching or global MVS
Robust photometric solve is posterior-constrained and fails closed on occlusion/exposure/dynamic inconsistency
Redundant active references can be replaced without losing sufficient resumable evidence
Physical repeated passes measurably reduce observable geometry error

nodes.title: Implement measured hierarchical displacement and normal refinement
acceptance: Depth/stereo/temporal residuals update analytic base versus displacement at the correct scale with posterior uncertainty
Recursive microtiles allocate only from supported projected footprint and consistent information
Normals derive from analytic plus displacement derivatives and carry confidence
Fine close geometry cannot be flattened by later coarse/distant observations
Relief, trim, pipe curvature, and small static detail improve across close revisits

nodes.title: Implement immediate surface-space RGB/EWA accumulation
acceptance: Charts receive inherent UV at creation and accepted visible RGB footprints accumulate directly into surface pages
Weights include sharpness, view/incidence, elliptical footprint, motion, occlusion, geometry confidence, exposure, and dynamics
Per-texel color information, variance, coverage, best footprint, and quality are resumable
Lower-quality imagery can add support but cannot overwrite sharper stable texels
Quest preview shows stable chart-space color without global unwrap/rebake

nodes.title: Implement measured multi-view texture superresolution and virtual pages
acceptance: Subpixel-shifted calibrated footprints accumulate with EWA weighting into sparse multiresolution surface pages
Page density follows best measured footprint and information, not blind upscale or one global texels-per-metre cap
GPU feedback/residency provides fallback mips without discarding maximum canonical detail
Revisit texture reprojection error decreases and accepted sampling detail is monotonic
Close physical captures resolve more measured texture detail than single-frame passthrough

nodes.title: Implement directional appearance and confidence-bearing PBR derivation
acceptance: GPU incremental fit separates robust view-stable appearance from SH1 baseline and promotes compact directional lobes only with evidence
Canonical directional measurements survive PBR derivation and restart
Base color, analytic/displacement normal, roughness, metallic, and material confidence are derived consistently
Insufficient roughness evidence uses a declared fallback and insufficient metallic evidence yields exactly zero
Quest viewer preserves supported view-dependent effects without Gaussian sorting or neural textures

nodes.title: Implement bounded revisit pose and chunk correction
acceptance: GPU residual reduction produces a robust point-to-chart 6x6 SE(3) correction only with adequate overlap/information
Meta pose/covariance remains a strong prior and raw frame timestamps/poses are immutable
Accepted revisit constraints update worldFromChunk through the existing pose graph without mutating local chart geometry
Renderer, association, persistence, future frames, and export consume one coherent transform snapshot
Long corridor loop and multi-floor return reduce drift without oscillation or global remesh

nodes.title: Implement direct PRISM-to-GLB/PBR chunk, region, and world export
acceptance: Stable PRISM charts/meshlets and requested appearance pages directly emit POSITION, NORMAL, TANGENT, UV0, indices, base color, normal, and metallic-roughness semantics without PLY
Boundary welding preserves topology and chunk nodes preserve final pose-graph transforms
Chunk, selected region, sharded world, and bounded flattened world modes publish atomically
Canonical PRISM state remains richer/resumable and is never replaced by the GLB derivative
Khronos glTF Validator and an independent importer accept generated and physical exports with correct transforms/materials

nodes.title: Pass physical whole-building quality, revisit, scale, and product acceptance
acceptance: Physical 5/10/20/50 mm plate sequence preserves independent front/back surfaces whenever sensor evidence resolves them and error improves across passes
Doors, frames, corners, recesses, pipes, poles, railings, trims, stairs, gaps, and oblique walls contain no supported silhouette bridges and refined boundaries beat raw depth where observable
For observable static targets repeated-pass geometry and texture error satisfy E5 < E2 < E1 and worse later views do not degrade better earlier state
Room, floor, stairwell, next floor, whole-building, restart, eviction, and return tests keep active cost local and every durable chunk rehydratable

Both RGB and both depth streams, exact rig/poses, posterior refinement, boundaries, stereo/temporal focusing, texture SR, directional/PBR appearance, realtime mesh, PRISM persistence, and GLB work fully offline on Quest
Production scenes/UI/setup/package no longer wire TSDF/DTSDF/Surface Nets/GS/DiffSoup/server reconstruction, while the archive branch retains historical recovery
